name: VNC Remote Desktop
description: Opens VNC servers (TigerVNC, x11vnc, macOS Screen Sharing, RealVNC with VNC password) from the devices console on desktop, Web and phone. The Host connects and authenticates; the viewer only ever sees an authenticated stream.

headless.reason: A viewer needs an interactive screen; a headless Host only bridges sessions for its paired devices (ADR-0234).

en.manifest.name: VNC Remote Desktop
